user.title: Wood Stove Mode
user.description: Choose the temperature sensors and the climate entities. Each location should have two redundant sensors.

data.water_sensor: Boiler system water temperature (from the OTGW)
data.nest_entity: Thermostat that talks to the OTGW (optional)

room.title: Add a TRV room
room.description: Every TRV room is inhibited in wood mode. Rooms marked as dump rooms receive the stove heat; all others are held closed. The inhibition entity is the input_boolean or switch that the vtherm_inhibition plugin watches for this room.

error.sensors_required: Choose at least one sensor for the stove and for the heat exchanger.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Wood Stove Mode is already set up.

data.stove_start_temp: Stove temperature that starts wood mode
data.exit_temp: Heat exchanger temperature that ends wood mode
data.reentry_minutes: Delay before wood mode can start again
data.start_opening: Valve opening when wood mode starts
data.sensor_diff: Largest accepted difference between two sensors
data.release_timeout: Time to wait for a room to be released
data.notify_mode: Notify when wood mode starts or ends
data.notify_nest: Notify when the thermostat setpoint is reset

error.band_order: The low end of the band must be below the high end.
error.aim_outside_band: The aim must be inside the band.
error.emergency_too_low: The emergency temperature must be above the top of the band.
